key_entities: CI is a venue, not a dependency rule
propositions: The project.portability criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell names only an undifferentiated 'CI', leaving 'no CI provider at all' unnameable as an alternate shape, so hard CI-only dependencies do not trigger a finding.

A capability whose sole trigger is a specific CI system (e.g. GitHub Actions schedule with no operation-linked fallback) is not portable and breaks projects with no CI provider or a different CI provider.

The criterion detection text, its test pinning, the hand-authored mirror in docs/plan-review-gate.md, and AGENTS.md guidance must all carry the same new Platform and venue cell and no-CI-provider rule wording to prevent silent drift.

Live A/B testing confirms that a plan with only a GitHub Actions compaction trigger and no fallback draws zero project.portability findings under the pre-change rubric and one finding under the post-change rubric, proving the detection rule is efficacious.
